AND 0100 logic

Bitwise AND ∧

One AND gate per bit position — used constantly to mask off bits.

Flags affected ZN

Bitwise AND runs four independent AND gates in parallel, one per bit position — there’s no carry chain here, so every bit resolves at the same time.

Where it’s used

Software uses AND to mask bits — clearing everything outside a region of interest. ANDing a byte with 00001111 keeps only its low nibble and zeroes the rest, which is exactly how this exhibit’s bit switches are read out.
